title: Credential stuffing against player accounts
description: Automated credential stuffing succeeds against weak or reused player passwords.
threat_scenario: External attacker replays breach credentials against the player login endpoint and harvests accounts that reused a password.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes twelve hours of elevated account resets, mandatory player notification and a one-week drop in new registrations.
existing_controls: Login rate limiting; breached-password screening; email step-up on new devices.
mitigation_plan: Roll out passkeys for player accounts and force a credential reset for any account matched to a breach corpus.
assumptions: Assumes twelve hours of elevated account resets and mandatory player notification.

title: Cheat injection through a modified game client
description: Modified clients bypass integrity checks and inject aim and wall-hack behaviour.
threat_scenario: Cheat vendors ship a bypass within hours of each integrity update, degrading competitive integrity.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes a measurable drop in new-player retention while detection lags the cheat release.
existing_controls: Client integrity attestation; signed telemetry; heuristic scoring before bans.
mitigation_plan: Add server-authoritative hit validation for ranked play and rotate cheat signatures every six hours.
assumptions: Assumes a measurable drop in new-player retention while detection lags the cheat release.

title: Virtual economy exploit allows item duplication
description: A gameplay service bug lets duplicated items reach the player-to-player market.
threat_scenario: A race condition in the trade service lets duplicated items reach the player-to-player market.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes duplicated items are traced and removed within one pricing cycle.
existing_controls: Server-authoritative inventory; trade audit log; daily economy reconciliation.
mitigation_plan: Make trade settlement idempotent and post a compensating ledger entry for detected duplicates.
assumptions: Assumes duplicated items are traced and removed within one pricing cycle.

title: Payment fraud and chargeback abuse in the storefront
description: Stolen payment instruments are used to buy virtual currency and then charged back.
threat_scenario: Stolen payment instruments buy virtual currency and are then charged back.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes the acquirer raises processing fees after the next fraud threshold breach.
existing_controls: Velocity fraud rules; 3-D Secure on high-risk baskets; device fingerprinting.
mitigation_plan: Introduce risk-based authentication at checkout and retrain the fraud model on the last four quarters.
assumptions: Assumes the acquirer raises processing fees after the next fraud threshold breach.

title: Storefront payment outage during a seasonal sale
description: A payment provider incident stops purchases during the highest-revenue weekend.
threat_scenario: A payment provider incident stops purchases during the highest-revenue weekend of the year.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes a four-hour outage at peak concurrent purchasing.
existing_controls: Secondary provider configured; failed purchases are queued and retried.
mitigation_plan: Implement automatic failover to the secondary provider with a rehearsed runbook.
scenario_name: Sale weekend payment outage - worst case
assumptions: Assumes a four-hour outage at peak concurrent purchasing.

title: Compromise of release signing keys in the build pipeline
description: Attacker access to pipeline secrets would let signed malware ship as a first-party update.
threat_scenario: Attacker access to pipeline secrets would let signed malware ship as a first-party update.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes withdrawal and re-signing of the affected release plus emergency patching.
existing_controls: Signing keys in an HSM; separated build and release roles; approved-change gate.
mitigation_plan: Enforce two-person control on release signing and issue short-lived pipeline credentials.
assumptions: Assumes withdrawal and re-signing of the affected release plus emergency patching.

title: Regional carrier failure during a global launch
description: A single upstream carrier loses routes and one region cannot reach matchmaking.
threat_scenario: A single upstream carrier loses routes and one region cannot reach matchmaking.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes one region is degraded for eight hours on launch weekend.
existing_controls: Anycast routing; multi-carrier peering; automated regional failover.
mitigation_plan: Add a third carrier in the affected region and rehearse a route withdrawal.
assumptions: Assumes one region is degraded for eight hours on launch weekend.

title: Non-compliance with age assurance and minors data rules
description: Age gating and parental consent controls do not meet current regional requirements.
threat_scenario: Age gating and parental consent controls do not meet current regional requirements.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes a supervisory fine plus a forced rebuild of the consent journey.
existing_controls: Documented age-assurance rules per region; parental consent capture; retention limits.
mitigation_plan: Commission an independent assessment of the consent journey against every region served.
scenario_name: Regulatory penalty and remediation - worst case
assumptions: Assumes a supervisory fine plus a forced rebuild of the consent journey.

title: Data breach at the player support SaaS provider
description: Support ticket data is exposed through a vulnerability in the hosted support platform.
threat_scenario: Support ticket data is exposed through a vulnerability in the hosted support platform.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes notification of affected players and a contractual security review.
existing_controls: Contractual security schedule; single sign-on only; annual vendor assessment.
mitigation_plan: Move support tickets to a vendor holding SOC 2 Type II and breach-notification SLAs.
assumptions: Assumes notification of affected players and a contractual security review.

title: Live telemetry gaps break matchmaking balance tuning
description: Ingestion lag starves the balance-tuning model and matchmaking quality drifts.
threat_scenario: Ingestion lag starves the balance-tuning model and matchmaking quality drifts.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes matchmaking quality drift is absorbed within normal player churn.
existing_controls: Schema validation on ingest; back-pressure alerting; replayable event log.
mitigation_plan: Accepted: monitor retention weekly and revisit if churn exceeds the agreed threshold.
scenario_name: Telemetry gap retention loss - base case
assumptions: Assumes a two-week telemetry gap mildly raises early churn.

title: Compromised launcher update channel distributes a malicious build
description: A hijacked update channel serves a trojanised launcher to players.
threat_scenario: A hijacked update channel serves a trojanised launcher to players.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes a full channel rollback and emergency client re-verification.
existing_controls: Signed artefacts; integrity manifest; origin locked to the release pipeline.
mitigation_plan: Publish a signed transparency log of released artefacts and verify it on the client before install.
assumptions: Assumes a full channel rollback and emergency client re-verification.

title: Insider exfiltration of an unreleased game build
description: A departing developer copies pre-release content out of the build pipeline.
threat_scenario: A departing developer copies pre-release content out of the build pipeline.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes leaked marketing beats and a first-week sales impact.
existing_controls: Least-privilege repository access; download logging; exit-interview controls.
mitigation_plan: Apply data-loss-prevention rules to build artefacts and stage the offboarding checklist.
assumptions: Assumes leaked marketing beats and a first-week sales impact.

title: Ransomware encryption of the player data warehouse
description: Domain-wide encryption halts analytics and the regulatory reporting pipeline.
threat_scenario: Domain-wide encryption halts analytics and the regulatory reporting pipeline.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes three days of degraded reporting and external forensics.
existing_controls: Immutable backups; endpoint detection; network segmentation of the warehouse.
mitigation_plan: Move the reporting warehouse to immutable offsite backups and rehearse a restore quarterly.
assumptions: Assumes three days of degraded reporting and external forensics.

title: Cryptomining abuse drives runaway cloud spend
description: Compromised service credentials are used to launch mining workloads inside the game account.
threat_scenario: Compromised service credentials are used to launch mining workloads inside the game account.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes the burst is caught by the monthly anomaly review rather than in real time.
existing_controls: Budget alerts; service-account scoping; workload tagging.
mitigation_plan: Add real-time cloud spend anomaly alerting and issue short-lived instance credentials.
assumptions: Assumes the burst is caught by the monthly anomaly review rather than in real time.

title: Unpatched image library on the launcher
description: A transitive image-decoding dependency carried a known remote code execution flaw.
threat_scenario: A transitive image-decoding dependency carried a known remote code execution flaw.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes exploitation is limited by the short window before the patched build shipped.
existing_controls: Dependency scanning in the pipeline; signed release; rapid patch process.
mitigation_plan: Completed: the patched build shipped to every channel and the library version is pinned.
scenario_name: Launcher remote code execution - base case
assumptions: Scenario retained for the assessment history after the patched build shipped.

title: Missing transport encryption on the legacy support portal
description: The legacy help site served authenticated pages over plain transport.
threat_scenario: The legacy help site served authenticated pages over plain transport.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes the short exposure window limits any credential interception.
existing_controls: Modern portal enforces HSTS; the legacy listener has been decommissioned.
mitigation_plan: Completed: the legacy listener was retired and the modern portal enforces transport encryption.
assumptions: Scenario retained for the assessment history after the legacy listener was retired.

title: Weak TLS configuration on the marketing landing pages
description: Landing pages negotiated deprecated cipher suites for legacy browsers.
threat_scenario: Landing pages negotiated deprecated cipher suites for legacy browsers.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes no measurable loss; treated as hygiene work.
existing_controls: Modern TLS profile enforced after remediation.
mitigation_plan: Completed: the legacy cipher profile was removed from the edge configuration.
scenario_name: Landing page cipher downgrade - base case
assumptions: Assumes a theoretical interception of an unauthenticated marketing session.

title: Stale support agent accounts with standing access
description: Former agents retained tool access after leaving the support floor.
threat_scenario: Former agents retained tool access after leaving the support floor.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes misuse is limited by ticket-level audit logging.
existing_controls: Quarterly access review; single sign-on deprovisioning on offboarding.
mitigation_plan: Completed: standing access was removed and access is now request-based.
scenario_name: Dormant agent account misuse - base case
assumptions: Assumes a dormant agent account is used to view player records.

title: Outdated container base image with a known kernel flaw
description: Production images ran a base layer with a local privilege-escalation flaw.
threat_scenario: Production images ran a base layer with a local privilege-escalation flaw.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes exploitation requires an existing foothold, which no evidence suggested.
existing_controls: Runtime hardening; no privileged containers; node-level patching.
mitigation_plan: Completed: base images were rebuilt on a patched layer and the pipeline pins the image digest.
scenario_name: Container escape from a compromised pod - worst case
assumptions: Assumes an attacker with a foothold escalates to the host and reaches neighbouring workloads.

title: Public read access on the analytics export bucket
description: An export bucket allowed anonymous reads of campaign performance data.
threat_scenario: An export bucket allowed anonymous reads of campaign performance data.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes limited loss; the exported data was aggregate and non-identifying.
existing_controls: Bucket policy restricted to the analytics principal; access logging enabled.
mitigation_plan: Completed: the public policy was removed and a guardrail prevents recurrence.
assumptions: Assumes the aggregate export is scraped before the policy is corrected.

title: Unmonitored privileged group changes in the studio directory
description: Additions to the privileged group were not alerted on, so escalation could go unnoticed.
threat_scenario: Additions to the privileged group were not alerted on, so escalation could go unnoticed.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes undetected escalation is caught at the next quarterly review.
existing_controls: Privileged access workstations; monitored break-glass accounts.
mitigation_plan: Completed: directory alerts now fire on any privileged-group change.
assumptions: Assumes an attacker escalates to directory administrator and persists until the quarterly review.

title: Deprecated third-party chat SDK in the launcher
description: A bundled third-party chat SDK reached end of support and no longer received fixes.
threat_scenario: A bundled third-party chat SDK reached end of support and no longer received fixes.
financial_impact_assumptions: Assumes the risk is contained by the SDK running in a sandboxed process.
existing_controls: The SDK runs sandboxed with no direct filesystem access.
mitigation_plan: Completed: the launcher shipped with the supported SDK release.
assumptions: Scenario retained for the assessment history after the supported SDK shipped.
